HSE Statistics Definitions
NearmissAn unplanned event that did not result in injury, illness, damage, or loss, but had the potential to do so if circumstances had been slightly different.
ViolationA deliberate or unintentional breach of company procedures, safety rules, regulations, or legal requirements.
First aid caseA work-related injury or illness that requires medical treatment beyond first aid
LTIsA work-related injury or illness that causes an employee to be unable to perform their normal work duties for workdays after the incident.
LWDsAn incident resulting lost workdays due to a work-related injury or illness.
ASRAccident Severity Rate = LWDs *200000/ Total working hrs. "A measure of the severity of workplace accidents, calculated based on the number of lost workdays due to injuries per 200000 man-hours worked"
AFRAccident Frequency Rate = LTIs *200000/ Total working hrs. "A measure of how often workplace accidents occur, usually expressed as the number of lost time injuries per 200000 man-hours worked"
